products.title: iPhone Duo 256GB
products.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone. It opens like a book to a 7.6-inch inner screen, and the outer screen keeps the same aspect ratio, so apps look the same folded or open.
products.imageCredit: Illustration: Rafael Fernandez (TheGoldenBox) · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
highlights: 7.6" inner display with nano-texture + 5.4" outer display
Dual 48MP rear cameras (Fusion Main with 2x, Ultra Wide)
IP68 · Star White or Night Sky

products.title: iPhone 18 Pro 256GB
products.description: Apple's smaller 2026 Pro phone. The main camera has a variable aperture for more control over depth of field, and the Dynamic Island is smaller.
products.imageCredit: Illustration: Rafael Fernandez (TheGoldenBox) · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
highlights: 48MP Fusion Main camera, variable aperture f/1.48–f/4

products.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB
products.description: The larger iPhone 18 Pro, with the same variable-aperture camera and A20 Pro chip and the longest battery life of any iPhone so far.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Kyu3a · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

products.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB
products.description: Samsung's top 2026 flagship phone, with a built-in S Pen, a privacy display and a four-camera zoom system.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Kyu3a · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
